snapshot_note: Concurrent integration snapshot; findings must be checked against final files before closure.

findings.location: g03.g0_convex3: exact_convex_view before freezing av/bv for oracle
findings.description: The independent oracle is handed vertices after the tested canonical hull view has discarded input points. A defect dropping a true extreme point in that shared preprocessing can make all three votes agree on the wrong reduced data.
findings.required_fix: Freeze the original raw coordinate sets before calling exact_convex_view. Independent SAT, difference hull and boundary probes must use those originals; compare local labels through coordinate-set mappings, not only canonical indices. Add a tested-path dropped-extreme mutation.

findings.description: A nonplanar source ring's Newell vector was treated as a support plane, allowing an adjacent truly planar face to merge even though the first ring had points off that plane.
sqrt(float(exact_squared_distance)) rounded 1e-400 to zero despite its square root 1e-200 being representable. Exact rational exponent scaling now precedes floating square root.

Polyhedron._convex_view plus local_facets/support-plane LRU caches can bypass newly monkeypatched inner code after a warm run on the same object. Fresh-process source mutants or explicit cache clearing are necessary to establish that the mutated path ran. Coordinate-keyed pure-function caches themselves preserve mathematical answers for unchanged inputs.

positive_checks: g03_exact imports no production geometry or filtered predicate; all determinants/SAT/support rings use inline Fraction operations.
Boundary probes are exact rational vertices, edge midpoints and facet vertex averages, with no conversion to float.
The SAT model includes all independent face normals and cross products of true oracle hull edges.
300 deterministic random integer 15-point clouds (Random(418), each coordinate in [-3,3]) produced valid oracle hulls without exception.
1225 exact L-prism closed-form memberships at scales 1e-200,1e-3,1,1e3,1e200 and 150 warped-roof closed-form memberships agree with exact surface API; filters_surface_closed_forms.json.
